rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~8.86% on a news event that is fundamentally negative (massive goodwill charge, shrinking margins, flat organic revenue), creating a classic "buy the rumor, sell the news" tension with no clear directional resolution. Price is sitting at 89.5% of today's range after a volatile session (low of $54.62 to high of $56.81), with the last five 1-minute candles showing indecisive, low-volume consolidation near the high — neither a clean continuation nor a reversal setup. With 4 working orders already consuming ~10% of buying power and the news-driven gap making stop placement difficult relative to ATR, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
